This browser does not save downloads by itself. Tap Save to Files and choose Save to Files (or Files) on the sheet that opens.
Walk view

Drag to look round. Wheel or W and S to walk, A and D sideways, Q and E down and up (Shift: bigger steps). With Trace, click to place a point on what the scan measured; it lands on the map too. Right-click undoes. The red lines are the house as the plan has it: move the scan with Free move until they sit on the real wall.

Not to scale yet. Measure a dimension you know and type its length.

Scale check

LinePlanTapeDiffDelete

Pick Measure, mark both ends of a dimension you know, such as a room width, then type its length. That first line sets the scale. Every line after it checks the plan against your tape.

Showing part of the sheet.
